data.name: Thank U, Next (Year)
data.headline: Thank u, next (year).
data.benefit: Thank u, next (year). This week is just for you: a guest pass to share, a members-only night, and a gift if you've hit 100 classes this year. No catch. Just gratitude (and glutes).
data.rationale: Each guest pass is a referral-quality lead (referrals convert 22–76%). Goodwill before December renewals lifts renewal yield.
data.conditions: No discount. Guest pass for someone new.
data.kpi: Guest passes used; guest → member (target 20%); December renewal yield.

data.name: Pop-Up, Don't Drop Out
data.headline: You popped in. Don't drop out.
data.benefit: You popped in. Don't drop out. Buy a pack within 72 hours of your trial: 15% off, 15 extra days, and a class to bring a friend.
data.rationale: 76% of pop-up revenue is single sessions/credits; only 26 10-packs in 12 months. Referral leads convert at 76%, so the friend class feeds the best channel.

data.name: Secret Santa Squats
data.headline: Secret Santa budget ₹2,000? Gift squats.
data.benefit: Secret Santa budget ₹2,000 and no idea? Gift 2 classes and grip socks. If they love it, half comes off their first month.
data.rationale: Secret Santa budgets cluster at ₹1–2k; a voucher at that price reaches new people through colleagues. Effective 20% on conversion.

data.headline: Black Friday, Strong Monday, sore Tuesday.
data.benefit: Black Friday, Strong Monday, sore Tuesday. Four days of the year's best long-plan prices — and the last Club Nine seats. No one-month discounts; we're not that kind of studio.
data.rationale: November is the trough (Kwality ₹18.5L, Bandra ₹13.2L in Nov-25). Long-plan pricing brings cash forward without discounting 1 Month.
data.kpi: Long-plan units; Club Nine seats closed out.

steps.text: Set up Black Friday, Strong Monday, Sore Tuesday in Momence (2027-11-26 to 2027-11-29): Fri 26–Mon 29 Nov: 6 Months at 20% (₹90,972 / ₹65,772), Annual at 25% (₹1,64,588 / ₹1,17,180, including leftover Club Nine numbered seats), 20- and 30-class packs at 20% (bulk). steps.text: Mid-month review against ₹1.8L: by the 15th aim for ~half of 48 new buyers (146 first visits), 11 renewals and 0 winbacks. Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
